changes.reason: s0499 dates Chonghua’s accession to 永和二年. His dispatch 遣使奉章于石季龍 in s0503 initiates the following reign narrative, and 季龍使 in s0504 gives Shi Hu’s own dispatch in that setting. This is living dispatch activity, not the later 季龍自斃 death notice. The contextual succession establishes onOrAfter AD346 only; the source does not date an exact campaign year.
